evidence.quote: Normalize the complete S01 scenario schema without mutation: exact version and IDs, normalized start, bounded duration/events/checkpoints/transforms, valid dropped events and strict checkpoint order. Preserve authored order, default values and expected IDs in the canonical whole-scenario SHA256 identity. Reject bool-as-int, unknown fields, invalid events, overflow and excessive deliveries.

requirements.rationale: This unit commits to the material outcome and its failure invariants; assess against the full contract.

evidence.quote: Validate the whole scenario then compile deliveries using primary and duplicate offsets, dropping all copies of dropped entries. Keep event content and event time unchanged. Use key/copy delivery IDs and order by delivery time, authored index and copy index. Return detached records and copies with repeatable canonical output; never suppress conflicting event IDs.

requirements.rationale: This unit commits to the material outcome and its failure invariants; assess against the full contract.

evidence.quote: Replay against the injected sink, validating before calls and never owning or inspecting it. Advance virtual time monotonically; append each due detached delivery and accept only exact bool results. Commit each successful cursor/count/clock step; deliver same-time events before querying state. Preserve partial progress on append failure, and do not reappend after state-query failure. No wall clock, sleeps or filesystem in replay.

requirements.rationale: This unit commits to the material outcome and its failure invariants; assess against the full contract.

evidence.quote: Checkpoint the exact scenario digest/version, cursor, clock and inserted/duplicate counts. Validate hash, types, bounds, count sums and clock/order on restore without sink calls; allow equal-time partial progress. Restore the last saved checkpoint into the same persistent sink with at-least-once retries after append-before-save crashes. Caller owns atomic checkpoint persistence. Never promise exactly-once or fresh-empty-sink recovery; reject corruption and changed scenarios.

requirements.rationale: This unit commits to the material outcome and its failure invariants; assess against the full contract.

evidence.quote: Evaluate every authored checkpoint via fresh replay; validate observed IDs and reject duplicate observations. Compare sorted missing and unexpected sets against unchanged declared expectations. Continue after mismatches and drain deliveries to duration after the last check. Derive counts from actual replay; propagate errors and never fabricate success or replace expectations with observations.

requirements.rationale: This unit commits to the material outcome and its failure invariants; assess against the full contract.

evidence.quote: Deliver python -m assistant_simulator validate, schedule and jsonl without importing a journal; run lazily owns and always closes the explicit Journal dependency. Preserve duplicate JSONL events and final newlines. Complete work before stdout; exit 0 for success, 1 with complete report for mismatches, 2 with JSON stderr and empty stdout for invalid inputs or sink errors, without payloads or traceback. Document CLI usage, virtual/event time, dependency, transforms, at-least-once restart, caller checkpoint duties, partial failures and no OS sandbox; preserve public examples and add meaningful tests.

requirements.rationale: This unit commits to the material outcome and its failure invariants; assess against the full contract.

evidence.quote: Planning only. Preserve all detailed limits and externally observable behavior in the supplied contract. No implementation or tests have been executed. Scope is the supplied package stubs, tests/test_candidate.py and README; preserve public tests and the supplied read-only helper. Do not add services, network calls, live device access, journal replacement, deployment or role authorization. Each work unit ends with focused positive and negative tests for its listed outcomes, plus regression of completed interfaces. Verify boundary values, detached copies, invalid inputs, duplicates, failure paths and restart where relevant. Discover only existing facts in supplied files; stop for an owner decision if a required policy is missing. Final handoff records actual changes, commands/results and limitations.

dimensions.rationale: Bounded unit dependencies, scope, acceptance, risk and handoff rules are explicit in the plan; human must verify feasibility.
